mechanisms.behavior: Three roller contacts plus lower VUK and upper stacking optos. Initial ball occupancy holds 11–14 active and 15 clear. Output 1 kicks the VUK ball to the shooter lane; contacts follow ball motion, not a direct coil-to-switch wire.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough and serve

mechanisms.behavior: The shooter lane switch senses the ball; the launch button requests output 2 to launch it.
mechanisms.label: Shooter lane auto launch

mechanisms.behavior: The script alternates Diverter1 and Diverter2 collision walls when output 17 changes. The manual states a hard Godzilla ramp shot goes left return with diverter UP and out the mouth when DOWN; the wall flag is not an independently proven physical UP mapping.
mechanisms.label: Godzilla ramp diverter

mechanisms.behavior: Three captive balls occupy separate lanes. A hit to either outer captive ball knocks the top center captive ball between its posts.
mechanisms.label: Three captive balls

mechanisms.behavior: The cabinet-bottom shaker motor is driven by output 6. The VPW callback produces shaker sound; its timing is table tuning, not a motor measurement.
mechanisms.label: Cabinet shaker

mechanisms.behavior: The factory chart lists left and right outlane save devices and an up/down post for UK only. Adjustment 51 requires the UK EPROM. Physical home state, device causality and timing are not established.
mechanisms.label: Optional UK post-save devices

mechanisms.behavior: The factory chart reserves output 8 for the optional European token dispenser and lists its part as Various (Call). Attachment topology, feedback and payout timing are not established; no absent attachment is simulated by assumption.
mechanisms.label: Optional European token dispenser

mechanisms.behavior: A 22-650 magnet coil uses a threaded bushing core; the retained table binds a separate magnet object to this output. No dedicated feedback sensor is established.
mechanisms.label: Top Orbit Magnet
